name: phone_status
description: Check Android connection status and available tools.

name: list_roots
description: List Android storage volumes currently available to OI Archivos.

name: list_files
description: List a folder in Android shared storage. Empty path opens primary storage.

connectionId.description: Optional saved connection ID from list_connections; omit for Android local storage.

name: file_info
description: Get metadata for a file or directory.

connectionId.description: Optional saved connection ID from list_connections; omit for Android local storage.

name: read_text
description: Read UTF-8 text from an accessible file, up to 64 KiB.

connectionId.description: Optional saved connection ID from list_connections; omit for Android local storage.

name: read_file_chunk
description: Read a binary file in up to 65536 byte base64 chunks. Continue with offset plus readBytes.

connectionId.description: Optional saved connection ID from list_connections; omit for Android local storage.

name: replace_text
description: Update an existing text file only when its SHA-256 matches expectedSha256 (from read_text). Requires owner-enabled changes. Local only; remote providers do not offer atomic conditional replacement.

connectionId.description: Optional saved connection ID from list_connections; omit for Android local storage.

name: make_directory
description: Create a new directory. Requires owner-enabled file changes.

connectionId.description: Optional saved connection ID from list_connections; omit for Android local storage.

name: write_new_text
description: Create a new UTF-8 file, never overwrite an existing file, max 64 KiB. Requires owner-enabled changes.

connectionId.description: Optional saved connection ID from list_connections; omit for Android local storage.

name: rename_file
description: Rename an existing file or directory, failing when the destination already exists. Requires owner-enabled changes.

connectionId.description: Optional saved connection ID from list_connections; omit for Android local storage.

name: copy_file
description: Copy an accessible file or directory without overwriting. Requires owner-enabled changes. Saved remote connections currently support individual files up to 8 MiB.

connectionId.description: Optional saved connection ID from list_connections; omit for Android local storage.

name: move_file
description: Move an accessible file or directory without overwriting. Requires owner-enabled changes. SFTP supports cross-folder moves; other remote providers may support same-folder rename only.

connectionId.description: Optional saved connection ID from list_connections; omit for Android local storage.

name: trash_file
description: Move a file to the application's recoverable trash, not permanent delete. Requires separately enabled trash permission. Local only; saved remote providers have no common trash contract.

connectionId.description: Optional saved connection ID from list_connections; omit for Android local storage.

name: device_capabilities
description: Query actual Android agent version and current read/write/trash/remote/delete permissions.

name: list_connections
description: List saved connections on the paired phone, without passwords or tokens. Device must allow remote connections.

name: write_new_file
description: Create a new binary file of up to 64 KiB from base64. Never overwrites an existing file.

name: delete_file
description: Permanently delete one file or an empty directory. Requires changes and permanent-delete enabled on phone. Never deletes a storage/connection root.

name: begin_upload
description: Begin a new local or saved-connection upload up to 256 MiB; requires expected size and SHA-256. The original destination is never overwritten.

name: upload_chunk
description: Append a base64 block up to 64 KiB at the exact offset. Identical retries are accepted.

name: commit_upload
description: Verify complete upload size and SHA-256, then publish a new local or remote file.

name: cancel_upload
description: Discard a pending upload and its temporary bytes.

name: debug_status
description: Check Shizuku readiness, Android shell UID and owner-enabled remote debugging. No root is used.

name: debug_device_info
description: Read device/app version and storage diagnostics. Requires owner-enabled remote debugging, no Shizuku required.

name: debug_list_apps
description: List installed app metadata, paginated. Requires owner-enabled remote debugging; never returns app-private data.

name: debug_run
description: Run a structured Android debugging action through owner-authorized Shizuku in ADB mode (UID 2000 only). No root or arbitrary shell. Changes require file-change permission; clear_data and uninstall also require permanent-delete permission. Screenshot needs a new absolute shared-storage path in value; read it with read_file_chunk. Output bounded to 64 KiB and execution to 12 seconds.
